{"type":"function","name":"subagent","description":"Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again: use the async tool with that id to wait for it, look at it or stop it. resume continues a finished run of this session as a new run. [can change files; runs to its end] is never handed off. [can change files; may run in the background] is handed off, keeps editing after your turn ends and cannot ask the user: leave its paths alone until it ends.\nAgents:\n- explore [can change files; runs to its end]: Finds facts.\n- finder: Reads notes.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents."},"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Agent name. Optional when only one is configured."},"resume":{"type":"string","description":"Run id (sub_...) of a finished run of this session to continue from its transcript. The new run is a copy: the old run is not changed, and the result names it as resumed_from."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time this call blocks for the answer; 0 returns a run id at once. Clamped to the async policy. An agent marked [can change files; runs to its end] ignores it and runs to its end."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"profile_message","description":"Send a message to another profile and wait up to block_ms for its final answer. If the profile answers in time you get the answer; otherwise (it is still working, or busy and your message waits its turn) you get an id and the message goes on: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. That profile keeps its own conversation between calls, so a later call can build on an earlier one. Profiles: review/reviewer.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"profile":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Profile to message: one of the available profiles, or \u003csession\u003e/\u003ccategory\u003e/\u003cprofile\u003e for a profile of another session this session may reach."},"message":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"The message to send. The profile sees nothing of this conversation."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time to block for the answer before an id is returned; collect it with the async tool."}},"required":["profile","message"],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
